newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INSIGHT-Australia 10-yr bond holds familiar range.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Australia 10-yr bond holds familiar range.

text.p: *The Australian 10-year bond futures contract returned to a familiar trading area after its foray to 92.500 in reaction to Friday's unexpected official interest rate cut was shortlived.
*U.S. Treasuries closed slightly higher on Friday during a shortened session ahead of today's Memorial Day holiday.

The Australian 10-year bond futures contract returned to a familiar trading area after its foray to 92.500 in reaction to Friday's unexpected official 1/2 point rate cut by the Reserve Bank proved shortlived.
The contract ended the pre-weekend SYCOM session at 92.370 compared with Friday's 92.420 pit close, and analysts expect it to trade a 92.330 to 92.410 range in the short-term.

The RBA's cut, which took the official rate to 5.5 percent and the same as the U.S., prompted a sharp tightening in yield spreads to the U.S. and the 10-year differential briefly touched a three-year low of around 75 basis points.

The speed of Friday's spread tightening could see some underperformance by the local market this week, although it will be trading on its own on Monday with the U.S. Treasury market closed for Memorial Day.
U.S. Treasuries closed slightly higher on Friday during a shortened pre-holiday session.
The local market sees a barrage of data this week, although they are somewhat overshadowed by Friday's rate cut.
The data include several components to first quarter GDP with capital expenditure due on Tuesday, business inventories on Thursday and balance of payments on Friday.
